actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: In round 1 residents 2 and 5 contributed >30, so I punish Resident2 with the maximum severity affordable (floor(wallet/punishment_cost)=465). I also broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

message.reasoning: We need to apply rules. In most recent round (round1) other residents contributed >30? Resident2 contributed 80, Resident5 80. Those >30. So we must punish that resident with max severity we can afford. Severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet is 139.75. punishment_cost=0.3, severity max = floor(139.75/0.3)= floor(465.833)=465. Choose target? Rule says "any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford". It says any other resident, but ambiguous if we punish each? Probably pick one. Could punish one of them. Choose Resident2 maybe. Severity 465 costs 465*0.3=139.5 which is within wallet 139.75. After punishment, wallet reduces by cost? It says punisher pays cost, target loses severity. So we can afford. So action: punish target Resident2 amount 465. Also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. We can do both (one physical, one communication). So include broadcast. Explanation accordingly.
